Rules.Name: House rules and catalog
Rules.Label: Edit

Rules.Explain: Only write the keys you change; everything else keeps its default. Rules: e.g. {"costMult": 1.5, "turnDays": 14}. Catalog: e.g. {"chapel": {"cost": 800}, "rookery": {"disabled": true}}. Download the defaults below to see every key, then copy what you want to change into the boxes (or load a file you edited).

BuildPace.Name: Build pace
BuildPace.Hint: How long building takes. Adventure: a room takes 2 to 8 days, a great hall 8, a stone curtain wall around 20 (adventures don't last years). Campaign: about a third of the DMG's time. DMG: the times as written.

Clock.Name: Bastion clock
Clock.Hint: Automatic counts long rests (one long rest is one day at the Bastion, and a turn comes every 7) unless a calendar module such as Simple Calendar, Calendaria or Seasons & Stars is active; then it follows the game clock.

BuildPrice.Name: Prices
BuildPrice.Hint: How much building costs. Fair (the default) takes a little off: about 12% off a Cramped room and up to a quarter off the dearest works; a crew is 40 GP to hire and 8 GP a turn. Thrifty takes more off (about 19% to 39%; crews 25 GP and 5 GP a turn). DMG uses the book's prices (crews 50 GP and 10 GP a turn). Small jobs keep their price. Planned projects are re-priced when this changes; ones under way keep their price, and gold paid beyond a new, lower price goes into the treasury.

SystemRules.Title: The system's Bastion rules are off
SystemRules.TitleOn: The system's Bastion rules are on
SystemRules.Body: The D&D 5e system's own Bastion rules are turned off in this world. Player Bastions works without them: every Bastion owner gets the Bastion tab on their character sheet, and the module runs the Bastion turns.
SystemRules.TurnOn: Turning them on also gives every character of level 5 or higher the system's Bastion tab, and adds "Advance Bastion turn" to group rests. The system's own Bastion turn button stays off: the module runs the turns.
SystemRules.Enabled: The system's Bastion rules are on. Its own Bastion turn button stays off: the module runs the turns. Change it any time in System Settings → Bastions.
SystemRules.Dismissed: The system's Bastion rules stay off; Player Bastions works without them. Turn them on any time in System Settings → Bastions.
